papers.title_en: Learning More from Less: Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight
papers.authors: Iris Xu, Sunshine Jiang, John Marangola, Nitish Dashora, Richard Li, Thomas Liu, Zexue He, Yuheng Zhi, Alex Pentland, Pulkit Agrawal, Zhang-Wei Hong
papers.evidence: 使用事后重标记进行强化学习奖励分配
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的强化学习后训练面临样本效率瓶颈：稀疏回报下，早期弱策略几乎每次尝试都失败，使得这些失败轨迹几乎无学习价值。本文提出事后学习（LfH），利用事后重新标记机制，将失败轨迹视为其他任务的成功执行，并通过一个视觉语言模型同时重标指令和奖励，从而从失败中挖掘学习信号。在LIBERO-PRO任务上，LfH实现了5倍样本效率提升，显著优于密集进度奖励基线，并且在多种VLA骨干及真实Franka机器人上保持了优势。该工作表明，通过语言空间的事后重新标记，可有效利用VLA的跨任务泛化能力，大幅提升从稀疏奖励中学习的效率。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, but every update consumes robot rollouts that are slow and costly to collect, making sample efficiency a central concern. Manipulation tasks typically provide only sparse rewards, so a weak policy fails almost every rollout early in training and has little to learn from, even when those failures execute coherent behavior. Such a failure, however, is a success at a different task. We present Learning from Hindsight (LfH), which brings hindsight relabeling to RL post-training of VLAs by scoring failed rollouts against the tasks they actually achieved. A single vision-language model relabels both the instruction and the reward, proposing a hindsight instruction for a group of failed rollouts and scoring how well each satisfies it, and the policy trains on the relabeled and original rollouts jointly. Because VLAs generalize across language, relabeling in language lets the policy learn more from the same trajectories. On out-of-distribution LIBERO-PRO tasks, where standard RL improves only slowly, LfH achieves $5\times$ improvement in sample efficiency, and outperforms a dense progress-reward baseline. The gains hold across VLA backbones and on a physical Franka robot.

papers.title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning using Ideas from Model Predictive Control
papers.authors: Georg Schäfer, Jakob Rehrl, Stefan Huber, Simon Hirlaender
papers.evidence: 适用于无人机巡检的安全深度强化学习框架
papers.tldr: 强化学习在复杂物理系统控制中面临探索阶段违反安全约束的风险，可能导致设备损坏。本文提出将模型预测控制的形式化安全保障与深度强化学习的自适应能力相结合，通过离线MPC计算可行状态-动作空间，并利用安全过滤器在线投影RL动作，确保探索始终在安全区域内。在非线性单自由度实物平台上验证了安全探索与策略稳定收敛，为安全RL在真实物理系统中的应用提供了可行框架。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables the synthesis of control policies directly from data, making it highly appealing for complex cyber-physical systems (CPSs) and robotics. A persistent challenge, however, is ensuring strict, hard safety constraints during the active learning phase. In real-world physical systems, violating mechanical limits can cause irreversible damage, necessitating that exploration remains strictly within safe operational regions. We propose a generalized framework that combines the adaptive, high-performance nature of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with the formal safety guarantees of model predictive control (MPC). Using a mathematical model of the system dynamics, offline MPC computations define a feasible state-action space, representing all safe combinations of system states and control inputs that guarantee constraint satisfaction. During training and deployment, the RL agent's instantaneous actions are projected onto this globally verified feasible set via a safety filter. We systematically evaluate our generalized approach on a non-linear 1-DoF laboratory testbed, demonstrating successful exploration and stable policy convergence on physical hardware.
